verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents running arbitrary shell commands or installing packages inside a Maritime sandbox. There is no exec endpoint, terminal command, or package-install flow. Related capabilities exist: custom Docker images as agents, micro-VMs, a GUI Linux desktop driven by screenshot/mouse/keyboard, and a Files API for disk edits. These are adjacent hosting and desktop features, not the stated shell-execution capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run arbitrary shell commands and install packages inside the sandbox
